pre_biopsy_corticosteroid: prednisone 50 mg, tapered to ~2 mg/kg/day, followed ~1 month later by a further mild taper
histology_summary: Marked biliary damage with partial duct lysis and portal endotheliitis; lymphoid-predominant mixed infiltrate (T cells CD3+/CD4+/CD8+, with scattered plasma cells, B cells, eosinophils and rare neutrophils); mild-to-moderate interface necrosis; absent steatosis, cholestasis and siderosis.

hepatitis_onset_phase: after chemotherapy completion, during pembrolizumab maintenance
histology_summary: Mild-to-moderate hepatitis with biliary epithelial damage (vacuolisation, nuclear dysmetria, apoptotic bodies); ducts present in >50% of portal tracts (not ductopenic); 35% macrovesicular steatosis (metabolic-syndrome co-factor).

second_line_post_biopsy: standard AIH induction: methylprednisolone 40-125 mg IV -> prednisone 50-75 mg
AIH_autoantibody_panel: ANA 1:640 (speckled); ASMA borderline; anti-SLA / LC-1 / mitochondrial / Gp210 negative
histology_summary: Severe plasma-cell-rich portal and interface hepatitis with rosettes, lobular plasma cells and emperipolesis; focal ductal damage with cholangitis; no clear ductopenia; no steatosis, cholestasis or siderosis.

second_line_post_biopsy: standard AIH induction: methylprednisolone 40 mg IV -> prednisone 50 mg
AIH_autoantibody_panel: ASMA 1:320; anti-SLA / LC-1 / mitochondrial / Gp210 negative
histology_summary: Moderate-severe plasma-cell-rich portal hepatitis with eosinophils, moderate-severe interface hepatitis and lobular inflammation; focal lymphoid infiltrate around ducts; rosettes and focal emperipolesis; no steatosis, cholestasis or copper-associated protein.
